name: google-ads
description: Free Google Ads account management by TrueClicks. Download account structure and performance data, run custom GAQL queries, and validate and execute changes in the live account.

interface.longDescription: Download a Google Ads account (structure plus 30-day, 7-day, or monthly performance) into a local folder as markdown, run custom GAQL queries, and push changes from pending_changes.json after a dry-run validation. Requires a free config.json from claudeppc.ai.
defaultPrompt: Download my Google Ads account structure and the last 30 days of performance.
Find keywords that spent money in the last 30 days without converting.
Validate my pending changes before I apply them.
